Windows was previously the only thing that could bring the service back, and only at boot: its built-in recovery fires on a crash, never on a service that was stopped cleanly. That was the gap that let two sensors disappear for days at a…
The Start sensor service button in Settings, System Scan remains as a last resort. It should now be unnecessary.
